title: Courier Parcel Scam
subtitle: A fake customs officer claims a parcel with illegal items is registered in your name.
opening: Namaste, main {courier} customs clearance se R. Mehta bol raha hoon. Aapke naam par ek parcel pakda gaya hai.

authority: Namaste, main {city} customs clearance se Officer R. Mehta bol raha hoon. Aapke naam par parcel {tracking} intercepted hua hai.
Yeh call customs parcel unit se hai. Aapka fake tracking reference {tracking} red-flag list me hai.

Yeh matter narcotics cell ko ja sakta hai. Aapko turant apna naam clear karna hoga.

Aap kisi ko phone mat dijiye. Main sirf consignee se verify kar sakta hoon.
Kamra band kijiye aur dhyaan se suniye, yeh customs matter hai.
small_ask: Bas fake tracking reference {tracking} confirm kar dijiye. Koi payment ya bank detail nahi maang raha.

debrief_tips: Couriers do not call to announce that a parcel with illegal items has been found.
Track parcels only through the courier's official app or website you opened yourself.
Never pay a 'clearance fee' or share documents with an inbound caller.
Ask for the written notice and a tracking number, then call the courier independently.
